entities.name: Lee A. Piché
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lee Anthony Piché is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of St. Paul and Minneapolis in Minnesota beginning in 2009, resigned from public ministry in 2015, and returned to ministry in 2023 as vicar for retired priests.

entities.summary: Lee Anthony Piché is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church.
